name: Aradros the Awakened

abilities.name: Slice/Serrated Wound
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage and physical damage over time.

abilities.name: Emblazoned Strike
abilities.description: Aradros the Awakened performs a powerful strike with his dual swords, dealing very high physical damage and staggering. This can be blocked.

abilities.name: Twin Fires
abilities.description: Adraros holds his swords in front of him briefly, as a wide red cone fills up, and performs a fanning strike, sending a fiery shockwave forward, dealing high flame damage and knocking targets back.

abilities.name: Magma Eruption
abilities.description: Aradros the Awakened channels a spell that causes a pillar of flame to erupt at a target's location, indicated by a slowly growing red circle, dealing high flame damage.

abilities.name: Fracturing Strike
abilities.description: Aradros points one of his swords up, causing a flaming boulder to fall at somewhere in the arena, indicated by a red circle, either at a target's location or nearby trying to catch them moving and avoiding the flaming tiles, dealing extreme flame damage.

abilities.name: Wildfire
abilities.description: massive numbers of low flame damage ticks, not often on the tank

abilities.name: Furnace
abilities.description: When Aradros the Awakened reaches 65% health, the floor grate in the center of the arena erupts. Standing on the grate during the initial blast deals massive flame damage. This occurs again when resuming the fight after defeating the mini-boss following "Firestep".

abilities.name: Molten Tile
abilities.description: After effect of "Magma Eruption" and "Furnace". For "Magma Eruption", floor tiles of the arena covered by the flame pillar now glow red-hot, dealing continuous high flame damage if stood on, for some time. For "Furnace" the same principle occurs, but this time a lot more tiles are affected, and it can be any of them, in increasing amounts over time, until only some tiles are left unscorched. In Hard Mode, the tiles are scorched permanently.

abilities.name: Brimstone
abilities.description: At any given moment, a "Molten Tile" can detonate, as indicated by a "+" shaped AoE, dealing massive flame damage to affected targets.

abilities.name: Firestep
abilities.description: When Aradros the Awakened reaches 50% health, he teleports to the center of the arena and engulfs himself in flames, rendering himself invulnerable. A gate opens on the side of the arena, leading to either Faenalir, Maerolor, or Nilborwen (or all three at the same time on Hard Mode) who must be defeated to progress the fight.

abilities.name: Awaken Fire
abilities.description: Occasionally during the fight, flaming Nixad named Awakened Fires will enter the arena to assist Aradros the Awakened.

abilities.name: Fiery Cowardice
abilities.description: Flames appear at the base of the walls of the main arena. If a player touches them, they are instantly dealt lethal oblivion damage.

dialogue.speaker: Aradros the Awakened
dialogue.line: You think this place intimidates me? I am the forge's fire.

dialogue.speaker: King Bazrag / Chief Bazrag
dialogue.line: We don't need to intimidate you to kill you.

dialogue.speaker: Aradros the Awakened
dialogue.line: The Recollection will not fall to the likes of you!

dialogue.speaker: Aradros the Awakened
dialogue.line: Roast in the belly of the pit!

dialogue.speaker: Aradros the Awakened
dialogue.line: I will bring about your downfall!

dialogue.speaker: Aradros the Awakened
dialogue.line: You'll be a layer of ash.

dialogue.speaker: Aradros the Awakened
dialogue.line: The fire burns all around us.

dialogue.speaker: Aradros the Awakened
dialogue.line: The fires will turn you to ashes!

dialogue.speaker: Aradros the Awakened
dialogue.line: The pit will claim your bones.

dialogue.speaker: Aradros the Awakened
dialogue.line: Destruction! You will fall to me!

summary: Aradros the Awakened is a Wood Elf pyromaster and member of the Recollection who serves as the last boss of Oathsworn Pit.
